metadata.question: On January 23, 2025 at 1:44 pm, did the smoke plume from the Baja California fire (El Escondido area of Ensenada) extend more than 100 km westward over the Pacific Ocean?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Dataset: GOES-West visible/IR (NOAA/GOES/18/MCMIPC), fallback to NOAA/GOES/17/MCMIPC.
- Time: Primary window 2025-01-23 21:35–21:55 UTC (~1:44 pm PST). Baseline window 19:00–21:00 UTC same day. If empty, widen to 21:20–22:10 UTC.
- Location: El Escondido area near Ensenada, Mexico. Use a westward corridor (2° lon by 1.8° lat) from the fire toward the Pacific.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Mask cold clouds using ABI band C13 (10.3 μm) brightness temperature threshold (BT < 285 K).
- Compute smoke proxy as positive anomaly in visible red band C02 relative to earlier baseline: delta = C02_now - median(C02_baseline); threshold delta > 0.02 and 0.07 < C02_now < 0.7.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If image collections empty after attempts: C1.
- If valid (non-cloud) pixels in ROI are zero: C2.
- If smoke present but min longitude fails (null/NaN) or negative distance: C3.
- Otherwise, compute farthest west smoke lon and convert to km; >100 km => A, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // Helpers for evaluate/getInfo style
  const evalEE = (obj) =>
    new Promise((resolve, reject) => obj.evaluate(resolve, reject));

  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const fireLat = 31.82;
  const fireLon = -116.60; // Ensenada area; west is more negative longitude
  const firePt = ee.Geometry.Point([fireLon, fireLat]);

  // Westward corridor ROI: 2° lon west of fire, +/-0.9° lat
  const lonW = fireLon - 2.0;
  const latMin = fireLat - 0.9;
  const latMax = fireLat + 0.9;
  const roi = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [lonW, latMin], [fireLon, latMin], [fireLon, latMax], [lonW, latMax]
  ], null, false);

  const targetStart1 = '2025-01-23T21:35:00Z';
  const targetEnd1   = '2025-01-23T21:55:00Z';
  const targetStart2 = '2025-01-23T21:20:00Z'; // fallback wider window
  const targetEnd2   = '2025-01-23T22:10:00Z';

  const baselineStart = '2025-01-23T19:00:00Z';
  const baselineEnd   = '2025-01-23T21:00:00Z';

  const collectionsToTry = ['NOAA/GOES/18/MCMIPC', 'NOAA/GOES/17/MCMIPC'];

  async function pickCollection(start, end) {
    for (const colId of collectionsToTry) {
      try {
        const col = ee.ImageCollection(colId)
          .filterBounds(roi)
          .filterDate(start, end);
        const n = await evalEE(col.size());
        if (typeof n === 'number' && n > 0) {
          return { id: colId, col, count: n };
        }
      } catch (e) {
        // try next
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  // Try primary window
  let picked = await pickCollection(targetStart1, targetEnd1);
  let timeUsed = [targetStart1, targetEnd1];
  if (!picked) {
    // Try fallback wider window
    picked = await pickCollection(targetStart2, targetEnd2);
    timeUsed = [targetStart2, targetEnd2];
  }
  if (!picked) {
    console.log(`Primary Images: 0`);
    console.log(`Baseline Images: 0`);
    console.log(`Valid Pixels: 0`);
    console.log(`Smoke Pixels: 0`);
    console.log(`Answer Window: ${targetStart1}–${targetEnd1} (fallback ${targetStart2}–${targetEnd2})`);
    console.log('C1: Empty Collection (No images found in date/location for one or both comparison points).');
    console.log('C1');
    return;
  }

  const colId = picked.id;
  const primaryCol = picked.col;
  const primaryCount = picked.count;

  // Baseline collection (same GOES id)
  let baselineCount = 0;
  let baselineCol;
  try {
    baselineCol = ee.ImageCollection(colId)
      .filterBounds(roi)
      .filterDate(baselineStart, baselineEnd);
    baselineCount = await evalEE(baselineCol.size());
  } catch (e) {
    baselineCount = 0;
  }

  // Build current and baseline images as medians
  const curImg = primaryCol.median().select(['CMI_C02', 'CMI_C13']);
  let baseImg = baselineCol ? baselineCol.median().select(['CMI_C02', 'CMI_C13']) : null;

  // If no baseline images, use a neutral zero baseline for delta; note in output
  const curC02 = curImg.select('CMI_C02');
  const curC13 = curImg.select('CMI_C13');

  let baseC02 = ee.Image(0).rename('CMI_C02');
  if (typeof baselineCount === 'number' && baselineCount > 0 && baseImg) {
    baseC02 = baseImg.select('CMI_C02');
  }

  // 2. Processing
  // Cloud/cold mask: keep warm pixels (likely smoke/clear) and valid C02
  const cloudFreeMask = curC13.gt(285);
  const validMask = curC02.mask().and(cloudFreeMask);

  // Smoke proxy: positive anomaly in C02 and moderate brightness limits
  const delta = curC02.subtract(baseC02).rename('delta');
  const smokeMask = delta.gt(0.02)
    .and(curC02.gt(0.07))
    .and(curC02.lt(0.7))
    .and(cloudFreeMask);

  // 3. Pixel counts
  const scale = 2000; // meters
  const totalCount = await evalEE(
    ee.Image(1).rename('one').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    })
  );
  const validCountDict = await evalEE(
    curC02.updateMask(validMask).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    })
  );
  const validCount = (validCountDict && validCountDict.CMI_C02) ? validCountDict.CMI_C02 : 0;

  if (!validCount || validCount === 0) {
    console.log(`Dataset: ${colId}`);
    console.log(`Primary Images: ${primaryCount} [${timeUsed[0]}–${timeUsed[1]}]`);
    console.log(`Baseline Images: ${baselineCount} [${baselineStart}–${baselineEnd}]`);
    const tot = totalCount && totalCount.one ? totalCount.one : 0;
    console.log(`Valid Pixels: 0 / ${tot}`);
    console.log(`Smoke Pixels: 0`);
    console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels (Images exist, but after cloud masking/processing, 0 pixels remain).');
    console.log('C2');
    return;
  }

  const smokeCountDict = await evalEE(
    ee.Image(1).updateMask(smokeMask).rename('smk').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    })
  );
  const smokeCount = (smokeCountDict && smokeCountDict.smk) ? smokeCountDict.smk : 0;

  // 4. Westward extent calculation
  const lonImg = ee.Image.pixelLonLat().select('longitude');
  const minLonDict = await evalEE(
    lonImg.updateMask(smokeMask).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.min(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    })
  );
  const minLon = minLonDict ? minLonDict.longitude : null;

  // 5. Validation & Final Answer
  const tot = totalCount && totalCount.one ? totalCount.one : 0;
  const cloudPct = (tot && validCount) ? (100 * (1 - (validCount / tot))) : 100;

  console.log(`Dataset: ${colId}`);
  console.log(`Primary Images: ${primaryCount} [${timeUsed[0]}–${timeUsed[1]}]`);
  console.log(`Baseline Images: ${baselineCount} [${baselineStart}–${baselineEnd}]`);
  console.log(`Valid Pixels: ${validCount} / ${tot} (Cloud/Cold Mask ~${cloudPct.toFixed(1)}%)`);
  console.log(`Smoke Pixels: ${smokeCount}`);

  if (smokeCount === 0) {
    console.log(`Westward Extent: 0.0 km (no smoke detected)`);
    console.log('B: No');
    return;
  }

  if (minLon === null || minLon === undefined || !isFinite(minLon)) {
    console.log(`Westward Extent: NaN (min longitude unavailable)`);
    console.log('C3: Calculation Failure (Result is None/NaN/invalid).');
    console.log('C3');
    return;
  }

  const dxDeg = fireLon - minLon; // Positive if smoke extends westward (to more negative longitudes)
  const kmPerDegLon = 111.32 * Math.cos(fireLat * Math.PI / 180.0);
  const dxKm = dxDeg * kmPerDegLon;

  if (!isFinite(dxKm) || dxKm < 0) {
    console.log(`Westward Extent: ${dxKm}`);
    console.log('C3: Calculation Failure (Result is None/NaN/invalid).');
    console.log('C3');
    return;
  }

  console.log(`Westward Extent: ${dxKm.toFixed(1)} km`);

  if (dxKm > 100) {
    console.log('A: Yes');
  } else {
    console.log('B: No');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
